title: Mushoku Tensei: The Displacement
alt: A dark plain of wheat fields under heavy storm clouds that turn about one place. From the clouds a wide column of blue-white light comes down on a walled town on the horizon, and the light swells out at its foot. A small red orb with a ring round it hangs in a hole in the clouds at the right. Trees and farms on the plain throw long shadows toward us. Near us is a dark hill with a black tree at the left, its leaves blown away, and at the right a staff of twisted wood with a glowing blue stone in its head leans on a rock.
summary: A painting of the Displacement from Mushoku Tensei in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the Displacement, from Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation, the novels by Rifujin na Magonote. On one afternoon the sky over the Fittoa region goes dark, and a red orb stands in the air. A column of light comes down on the citadel of Roa. Then the light takes the whole region, and every person in it is thrown to some far part of the world.
The staff with the blue stone is the one that Rudeus was given on that day, for his tenth birthday. No one is in the picture. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
